The left and right edges of each puzzle piece have protruding or recessed connecting shapes; the puzzle piece labeled 1 has a straight outer edge on the left and a protruding connection on the right; the puzzle piece labeled 3 has matchable recessed connections on the left side and the right side; the puzzle piece labeled + has protruding connections on the left and right; the puzzle piece labeled 2 has a recessed connection on the left side and a straight outer edge on the right. Reasoning: When matching according to the connecting shapes, the protruding connection on the right side of 1 can connect to the recessed connection on the left side of 3; the recessed connection on the right side of 3 can connect to the protruding connection on the left side of +; the protruding connection on the right side of + can connect to the recessed connection on the left side of 2. Therefore, the assembled rectangle reads 13+2 from left to right. Calculate 13+2=15.

method.method_draft: Visually assemble the pieces by matching complementary jigsaw edges. From the image, read the four labels on the pieces as 3, 2, 1, and +. Use the connector shapes: the piece labeled 1 has the flat outside left edge and a right tab; that right tab fits the left recess of the 3 piece. The right recess of the 3 piece then fits the left tab of the + piece, and the right tab of the + piece fits the left recess of the 2 piece, leaving the 2 piece with the flat outside right edge. Thus the rectangle reads left to right as 13+2. Compute 13+2=15.

method.method_draft: Treat the puzzle as a connector-constraint sequence problem. From the image, encode each piece by its left and right edge type: 1 has a straight left edge and a right tab; 3 has matching recesses on both sides; + has tabs on both sides; 2 has a left recess and a straight right edge. A rectangle made from a single row must start with the only straight-left piece and end with the only straight-right piece, so it starts with 1 and ends with 2. The only connector-compatible path using all pieces is 1 → 3 → + → 2. Therefore the calculation printed on the rectangle is 13+2, whose value is 15.
